content:
Hello Mathlib developers: I'm interested in working on some Lean proofs around finite-sample ordinary least squares. I was going to start small by developing OLS-specific formulations of a few basic properties (e.g., least-squares minimization, residual orthogonality, etc) with small PRs.

If there are already closely related libraries or work, I would prefer to extend them. I did notice that Mathlib already proves several of the main ingredients around orthogonal projection distances which I would plan to use. I'm also happy to elaborate more about what I'm interested in doing, but I want to keep this message short. Thank you and I welcome any guidance or input.
